title: Globally Distributed Self-Driving Labs Autonomously Discover 21 Organic Laser Emitters
aiSystem: Delocalized Multi-Lab Asynchronous AI Orchestrator (Toronto / UIUC / UBC / Glasgow / Kyushu)
whyItMatters: First cloud-orchestrated network of five autonomous laboratories across three continents asynchronously synthesized and tested >1,000 molecules, discovering 21 state-of-the-art organic solid-state laser emitters.
summary: Published in Science in May 2024 by Felix Strieth-Kalthoff, Han Hao, Vandana Rathore, Martin D. Burke, Jason E. Hein, Leroy Cronin, Bartosz A. Grzybowski, Chihaya Adachi, Alán Aspuru-Guzik, and colleagues across five international laboratories (Toronto, Illinois, Vancouver, Glasgow, and Fukuoka), this breakthrough demonstrated the first delocalized, asynchronous closed-loop self-driving laboratory network. Using automated iterative Suzuki–Miyaura cross-coupling synthesis, automated photophysical characterization, and a central cloud-based AI optimization engine navigating >150,000 candidate molecules, the distributed robotic network synthesized and evaluated more than 1,000 novel organic compounds—discovering 21 top-performing organic solid-state laser (OSSL) gain materials, including two emitting at record-low amplified spontaneous emission thresholds.
technicalHighlights: Coordinated five geographically distributed automated laboratories asynchronously via a cloud AI planner sharing experimental feedback in real time.
Synthesized, purified, and optically characterized >1,000 novel organic molecules from a 150,000+ combinatorial chemical space via automated Suzuki–Miyaura block chemistry.
Discovered 21 state-of-the-art organic solid-state laser emitters validated in physical thin-film lasing devices.
caveats: Required standardized modular building-block chemistry (MIDA boronates) and human oversight for instrument maintenance, sample shipping between specialized optical-device fabs, and initial chemical-space definition.

scoreRationale.foundational: Demonstrated that autonomous discovery can transcend single-room robotics into a globally distributed, asynchronously orchestrated cloud laboratory.
scoreRationale.ripple: Established the operational template for multi-institution self-driving laboratory consortia across chemistry, photonics, and pharmaceuticals.
scoreRationale.verification: Peer-reviewed in Science with physical synthesis, spectroscopic characterization, and thin-film lasing confirmation of all 21 emitters.
scoreRationale.velocity: Screened >1,000 newly synthesized compounds across five continents in a single closed-loop campaign to uncover 21 top-tier laser materials.
